caption: The drawing depicts a stylized cross at the top, colored in a muted gold shade and outlined in red, with light blue and teal accents within its sections. Behind the cross, there are subtle yellow rays emanating outward. Directly below the cross is a bow or ribbon shape, with four loops outlined in teal and dotted with red and gold details, converging at a circular knot at the center. On both sides of the ribbon shape, there are symmetrical, stylized gold wings with three red tips on each. Below the bow is a large circular medallion filled with geometric, symmetrical patterns. The medallion contains concentric circles and radiating shapes in gold, red, and teal, featuring repeating triangular and petal-like motifs. The overall background of the drawing is a textured beige, resembling aged parchment. The color palette primarily consists of muted gold, red, teal, and blue on the beige background.
title: Santa Barbara Mission Doorway Design from the portfolio "Decorative Art of Spanish California"
